reviews.text:
Love the skincare ingredients in it, can be a bit greasy especially in heavy humidity or on top of products.
Overall impressed, better suitable for autumn winter or for dry skin.
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意佢嘅護膚成分，不過可能會有少少油膩，尤其係濕度好高嗰陣，或者喺其他產品上面用嗰陣。
整體嚟講我幾滿意，更加適合秋冬或者乾性皮膚用。

reviews.text:
This is the best face sunscreen, I let my friend try it and she doesn't use sunscreen as sge hates how sunscreen sits on her face and has now started using this sunscreen.

When I was in Korea, I had my skin tested and they said my sunscreen was good as it let nothing in.
reviews.zh:
呢款係最好嘅面部防曬，我叫朋友試吓，佢本來唔用防曬，因為佢好憎防曬喺面上嗰種感覺，而家佢開始用呢款。

我喺韓國嗰陣，做過皮膚測試，佢哋話我嘅防曬好，因為冇俾任何嘢入侵皮膚。

reviews.text:
I have very dry and sensitive skin and I must say this is my holy Grail in terms of sun protection. I do have this perimenopausal skin and if anyone has perimenopause they understand that the dryness is real and this is the only one non-irritating and very effective sun protection cream that I found so far and I tried a lot of of them. Just for you to understand how sensitive my skin is that Centella blue suncream did not work well for my skin I gave it to my husband, who has normal skin and it works great for him. I will be purchasing this forever, I’m super excited that I found this product. 👏🏻☺️ and also I didn’t get sunburn even once using this SPF not even my nose or forehead, next to my hairline where I always used to get sunburned even wearing SPF 😳 
it’s really great under the make-up, I even mixing a little bit in my foundation, nicely hydrating ♥️
reviews.zh:
我嘅皮膚好乾同好敏感，我必須講，喺防曬方面呢款係我嘅神級產品。我而家有圍絕經期嘅皮膚，如果有人試過圍絕經，就會明白嗰種乾燥係真實嘅。呢款係我至今試過好多款之後，唯一冇刺激、防曬效果又好強嘅防曬霜。等你哋明白我個皮膚幾敏感：Centella 藍色防曬霜對我嘅皮膚效果唔好，我就俾咗畀我老公，佢皮膚正常，用落好好。我會永遠買呢款，我好興奮可以搵到呢款產品。👏🏻☺️ 另外，用呢款防曬，我一次都冇曬傷，連鼻同額頭都冇，就係近髮際嗰度，我以前就算用咗防曬都會曬傷 😳
喺底妝下面真係好好，我甚至會落少少喺粉底度，好滋潤 ♥️

reviews.text: Excellent absorption. Zero stickiness. It is a great one to use if you use BB cream, as it leaves no marks or lines. It is also great to find a sun cream that absorbs quickly and does not leave white trails.
reviews.zh: 吸收非常好，完全唔黏。如果你會用BB霜，呢款好啱用，因為唔會留低印記或者紋路。仲有，想搵一款吸收快、唔會留白痕嘅防曬，呢款都好好。

reviews.text:
The best sunscreen I have used to date!

This is such a wonderful sunscreen that is jam-packed full of amazing skincare ingredients! The serum instantly sinks into my skin and provides a beautiful glow base for foundation. The finish is so lovely that my husband actually thought I was wearing makeup!
reviews.zh:
係我至今用過最好嘅防曬！

呢款防曬真係好好，充滿咗好多好正嘅護膚成分！精華即刻滲入皮膚，為粉底提供一個好靚嘅光澤底妝。效果好靚到，我老公竟然以為我化咗妝！

reviews.text:
I love it 
I’ve been using the BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Essence Sun Cream for a couple of weeks now, and I’m really pleased with it. The texture is light and absorbs quickly, leaving my skin feeling moisturised without any stickiness. It doesn’t leave a white cast. My skin feels looks good
reviews.zh:
我好鍾意！
我用咗 BIOHEAL BOH Probioderm Collagen Essence Sun Cream 差唔多兩個禮拜，我好滿意。質地輕盈，吸收快，皮膚感覺滋潤，冇黏膩感。唔會有白cast。我嘅皮膚感覺同睇落都好好。

reviews.text: Korea is the reason behind my obsession with sunscreens, I’m always ready to give them my money lol I saw someone saying this is the sunscreen Koreans actually use in Korea, I’m not sure how true that is, but it’s such a lightweight and hydrating formula that I can see it being a favorite. I’ve been loving the glowy finish it leaves behind and it’s been perfect for this in between weather we’re having in NY, where it’s super cold mornings and nights but humid in the afternoons
reviews.zh: 我會痴迷防曬都係因為韓國，我成日都準備好畀錢買佢哋 lol。我見有人話呢款係韓國人喺韓國真正用嘅防曬，我唔肯定幾真，但係佢質地好輕盈、保濕，我睇到會成為我嘅心頭好。我好鍾意佢留低嘅光澤感，而且好啱我哋紐約而家呢種過渡季節嘅天氣，早朝同夜晚好凍，但係下晝就好潮濕。

reviews.text: I want to love this sunscreen. I purchased it because of the impressive skincare ingredients within. But, so far, it’s getting off to a rocky start. This sunscreen is moisturizing and very dewy, can even be greasy finish on me. I’ve tried it with and without moisturizer, still trying to figure out what works best with it. It also caused a few breakouts after not experiencing any for the past month. It does spread easily and has zero white cast.
reviews.zh: 我好想鍾意呢款防曬。我買係因為佢入面嘅護膚成分好吸引。但係，目前嚟講，開頭都幾唔順利。呢款防曬好保濕，而且好水潤（dewy），甚至我皮膚上會有啲油膩嘅效果。我試過加／唔加保濕霜去用，仍然喺度研究邊個配搭最好。另外，喺過去一個月冇爆痘之後，用咗呢款就爆咗幾粒。佢好容易推開，亦完全冇白cast。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
